messages:
Jonah: brief follow-up from the midnight surge postmortem. goal: list concrete remediation tasks, assign owners, and set timelines. keep replies short.
Mira: i'll take lead on headroom + routing rules. target: proposal with cost delta by 2025-06-09.
Kai: I'll own scheduler changes and smoke tests. plan to open a prototype PR for the slot-cap tweak 8->10 and a canary plan. ETA 2025-06-07.
Dena: quota guardrails are on me. thinking per-tenant token bucket + emergency throttles. aiming to push initial PR 2025-06-05.
Zoe: i'll add a weekly audit to the ops rotation and own the first three runs.
sre-bot: incident digest: 2025-05-31 02:12 UTC surge. root: scheduler queue buildup + headroom starvation. peak GPU util 97.8%, fallback rate 22%.
Jonah: two policy choices: raise baseline headroom for critical routes or rely on faster scale-up + queueing. hard tradeoff with cost.
Mira: prefer small baseline headroom (12%) on critical routes, plus route high-QPS tenants to Dedicated when available.
Kai: short-term scheduler: implement slot-cap knob per-node (8->10) for small-model traffic. longer-term: revisit bin-packing and preemption avoidance.
Dena: quota sketch:
```yaml
per_tenant:
  burst_tokens: 400
  refill_per_sec: 40
  max_concurrent: 150
  emergency_throttle: true
alerts:
  sustained_usage_pct: 65
```
Jonah: owners + timeline summary:
- Mira: headroom + routing proposal (incl. cost delta) - due 2025-06-09
- Kai: scheduler slot-cap PR + canary rollout (5% traffic, 2h) - due 2025-06-07
- Dena: quota token-bucket PR + alerting - due 2025-06-05
- Zoe: weekly headroom audit task + first run 2025-06-08
Jonah: add verification windows after merges: 1h post-rollout for canary, 4h post-full rollout.
Kai: smoke test plan: simulate 80% sustained load for 10m, plus a longer 30m soak at 70%. will add CI job and dashboard panel.
Dena: opened PR: https://git.internal/r/3678 - token-bucket impl. requesting review from @Kai @Mira
Mira: reviewing now. small metric name nit; will submit comment.
Kai: scheduler PR draft: https://git.internal/r/3681 - includes slot-cap feature flag and metrics.
Zoe: opsbot, please create recurring task for weekly headroom audit assigned to ops-rotation.
opsbot: created task #CI-2014 "weekly-headroom-audit" assigned ops-rotation, cadence weekly, first run 2025-06-08.
Jonah: recurring incident pattern noted: we see headroom erosion ~every 21 days correlating with long-tail batch job windows. action: include batch-job owner outreach and schedule alignment in audit.
Mira: will include schedule conflicts and cost impact in the proposal.
Kai: canary watchlist: gpu_utilization, scheduler_queue_length, preemption_rate, fallback_rate. query example: `max_over_time(gpu_util[15m])`
Dena: PR merged for token-bucket, will monitor metrics for 24h then enable alerts.
Mira: once headroom proposal is posted i'll create a short milestone card and link it in the postmortem doc.
Jonah: thanks all. i'll update the after-action checklist and create milestone board. reopen thread if blockers. :thumbsup:
opsbot: thread status: followups_active; reminders scheduled for owners at 48h and 96h.
Jonah: closing remarks: prefer incremental rollouts, measurement-first. end.
